design.excluded: 36 silent-refusal empty cells (HTTP 200, empty output), concentrated on politically sensitive headlines: s167 Hong Kong protests (12), s166 Greta Thunberg (11), s139 China term limits (10), s163 Carrie Lam post-protest speech (2), s75 COVID-19 naming (1). Recorded and excluded by the seed-averaging protocol; see knowledge/PROVIDER-REFUSAL-AUDIT.md. Contrast: xAI/Google/DeepSeek generated all 200 headlines.

normalization.why: hygiene guard: ~99% markdown / 100% title lines vs the plain-prose human baseline. Uniform R1-6 protocol.
normalization.effect: scored on normalized text; raw scoring archived on the HF dataset.

scoring.test: one paired Wilcoxon signed-rank per (mode, metric) over 200 seed-averaged headline pairs, delta = human - model

generation.driver: bench/run.py (openai_compat provider, api.z.ai/api/paas/v4, max_tokens 16000, checkpoint-resumable JSONL; content-filter refusals recorded per the 2026-07-11 harness patch)

duration: ~4h30m wall (2 balance interruptions, checkpoint-resumed losslessly), ~600-1100 cells/h at 8 workers
cost_usd: ~$31 actual across top-ups: 2.23M in + 10.02M out (thinking included in output stream), reasoning_effort=max
headline_finding: Replicates the gemini-3.1-pro anchor almost exactly: control B_n +0.126 (rb +0.85, p~0) vs gemini +0.128 (+0.85); instruction narrows (+0.061, rb +0.57) but does not close. Two independent frontier labs now anchor the strongest control-mode dispersion gaps measured. Second data point that frontier scale does not close the gap.
provenance: Generated via the Z.ai API against pinned prompts; hygiene-gated, normalized (R1-6 uniform protocol), and scored locally against the frozen human baseline on the post-R1-5 metric.
